evidence: io.lisp:793 fnn-read-regular-bounded: (fnn-open path o-rdonly nofollow) then fstat. fnn-archive-entry (io.lisp:4900-4906) reads profile/frontier/config/records through it after an lstat check; fnn-stopped-observation reads config.json (io.lisp:5763). A FIFO swapped in between the lstat and the open blocks. Needs write access to the archive or store directory. About 69 call sites share the helper.
fix: Open NONBLOCK in the shared helper and refuse a non-regular descriptor before reading, as io.lisp:5256 and :5724 do.
title: fnn-read-regular-bounded opens without O_NONBLOCK, so the FIFO-substitution hang fixed for the import MANIFEST (E013) and the status prefix reader (E014) remains for every other archive entry and stopped-status config.json
